t1.title: The bar chart shows the percentage of students choosing four types of school activity in 2000 and 2020.
t1.zh: 柱状图显示了 2000 年和 2020 年选择四种校园活动的学生比例。
hints: Report the overall pattern before selecting details.
Group the larger and smaller changes.
Use the same unit when comparing both years.

t2.title: Some people believe schools should focus mainly on academic subjects, while others think practical skills are equally important. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
t2.zh: 有人认为学校应主要关注学术科目，也有人认为实践技能同样重要。讨论双方观点并给出你的看法。
hints: Address both views before making your position clear.
Use one concrete example for each main reason.
Make the conclusion consistent with your introduction.

t1.title: The table compares average weekly working hours and job satisfaction in five occupations in 2015 and 2025.
t1.zh: 表格比较了 2015 年和 2025 年五种职业的平均每周工时和工作满意度。
hints: Notice which occupations share a pattern.
Compare working hours and satisfaction separately.
Avoid listing every cell in the table.

t2.title: Many people now work from home. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
t2.zh: 如今许多人在家工作。这样做的优点是否大于缺点？
hints: Decide clearly which side outweighs the other.
Compare effects on workers and employers.
Support your view with a specific example.

t1.title: The line graph shows the percentage of households with internet access in three countries from 2005 to 2025.
t1.zh: 折线图显示了 2005 年至 2025 年三个国家拥有互联网接入的家庭比例。
hints: Identify the overall direction and starting points.
Compare how quickly the lines change.
Use approximate language when describing values.

t2.title: Technology makes communication easier, but it can also reduce face-to-face interaction. Discuss both sides and give your opinion.
t2.zh: 科技让沟通更容易，但也可能减少面对面交流。讨论两方面并给出你的看法。
hints: Explain convenience and its possible social cost.
Distinguish online contact from in-person interaction.
Give a balanced position rather than a list.

t1.title: The diagram illustrates how household waste is collected and processed for recycling.
t1.zh: 流程图展示了家庭废弃物如何被收集并处理以供回收利用。
hints: Describe the stages in the order shown.
Use passive forms where the agent is not important.
Do not add a cause or benefit that the diagram does not show.

t2.title: Governments should prioritise environmental protection even when it slows economic growth. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
t2.zh: 即使环境保护会减缓经济增长，政府也应将其列为优先事项。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
hints: State the degree of agreement clearly.
Explain how environmental policy and growth may interact.
Develop reasons instead of repeating the question.

t1.title: The bar chart compares healthcare expenditure per person in six countries in 2000 and 2020.
t1.zh: 柱状图比较了六个国家在 2000 年和 2020 年的人均医疗支出。
hints: Find the highest and lowest values.
Compare the overall level and the size of change.
Keep the unit clear when reporting numbers.

t2.title: Public money should be spent on preventing illness rather than treating people after they become sick. Do you agree or disagree?
t2.zh: 公共资金应更多用于预防疾病，而不是在患者患病后进行治疗。你是否同意？
hints: Consider prevention and treatment as complementary needs.
Explain which public investment should receive priority.
Use a realistic example, not an absolute claim.

t1.title: The maps show changes to a town centre before and after a transport redevelopment project.
t1.zh: 两幅地图展示了交通改造项目实施前后市中心的变化。
hints: Group the changes by area or type.
Use accurate location language.
Distinguish what was added, removed or relocated.

t2.title: Some people think cities should be designed for cars, while others support pedestrian-friendly planning. Discuss both views.
t2.zh: 有人认为城市应以汽车出行为中心设计，也有人支持以行人友好为重点的规划。讨论双方观点。
hints: Discuss mobility needs and effects on public space.
Compare who benefits from each approach.
Acknowledge that city needs may differ by area.

t1.title: The pie charts show how household spending was distributed among six categories in 2000 and 2020.
t1.zh: 饼图显示了 2000 年和 2020 年家庭支出在六个类别中的分布。
hints: Compare the largest shares first.
Describe increases and decreases without naming every slice.
Check that each year sums to 100 percent.

t2.title: Advertising encourages people to buy things they do not need. Is this a positive or negative development?
t2.zh: 广告鼓励人们购买不需要的东西。这是积极还是消极的发展？
hints: Choose an overall judgement and sustain it.
Consider consumers, businesses and wider effects.
Separate evidence from broad generalisations.

t1.title: The table gives the number of people using four news sources in 2010 and 2020.
t1.zh: 表格列出了 2010 年和 2020 年使用四种新闻来源的人数。
hints: Identify the sources that rise and fall.
Use absolute figures and percentages appropriately.
Group sources with similar trends.

t2.title: The media has too much influence on how people think. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
t2.zh: 媒体对人们思维方式的影响过大。你在多大程度上同意或不同意？
hints: Clarify which forms of media you mean.
Weigh influence against the audience's ability to judge.
Use a bounded example rather than a universal claim.

t1.title: The line graph shows the number of international visitors to three cultural sites between 2010 and 2020.
t1.zh: 折线图显示了 2010 年至 2020 年三处文化景点的国际访客人数。
hints: Compare both the final values and the pace of change.
Notice whether any site catches up with another.
Avoid speculating about reasons for the trends.

t2.title: International tourism can damage local culture and the environment. What problems does it cause and how can they be solved?
t2.zh: 国际旅游可能损害当地文化和环境。它会造成哪些问题，又可以怎样解决？
hints: Link each proposed solution to a problem.
Consider residents as well as visitors.
Avoid claiming tourism is entirely harmful or beneficial.

theme: 混合题型与完整限时练习

t1.title: The chart compares the proportion of public spending on education, employment services and housing in 2012 and 2022.
t1.zh: 图表比较了 2012 年和 2022 年公共支出中教育、就业服务和住房所占的比例。
hints: Summarise the overall allocation before the details.
Compare which category gained or lost share.
Keep your comparisons within the data shown.

t2.title: Some people believe every major social problem has a technological solution. Discuss this view and give your own opinion.
t2.zh: 有人认为每个重大社会问题都有技术解决方案。讨论这一观点并给出你的看法。
hints: Distinguish problems technology can address from those needing social change.
Explain limits as well as benefits.
Use a specific example and return to your position.
